title: Comprehensive Directory of National Parks, Tiger Reserves, and Ramsar Wetlands

records.name: Jim Corbett National Park
records.key_species: Bengal Tiger, Elephant, Leopard
records.facts: India's first National Park, established in 1936 as Hailey National Park. First park where Project Tiger was launched in 1973. Ramganga river flows through it.

records.name: Kaziranga National Park
records.category: National Park & UNESCO World Heritage Site
records.key_species: Great Indian One-horned Rhinoceros, Wild Water Buffalo, Swamp Deer
records.facts: Hosts two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses. Located along the floodplains of Brahmaputra River.

records.name: Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary
records.key_species: Asiatic Lion (Panthera leo persica), Chital, Sambar
records.facts: The only natural wild habitat of the endangered Asiatic Lion in the entire world.

records.name: Ranthambore National Park
records.key_species: Royal Bengal Tiger, Leopard, Marsh Crocodile
records.facts: Bounded by Chambal River to the south and Banas River to the north. Famous for historic 10th-century Ranthambore Fort inside the park.

records.name: Sundarbans National Park
records.category: National Park, Biosphere Reserve & UNESCO World Heritage Site
records.key_species: Royal Bengal Tiger (swimming tigers), Estuarine Crocodile, Gangetic Dolphin
records.facts: World's largest mangrove ecosystem. Formed by confluence of Ganga, Brahmaputra, and Meghna rivers.

records.name: Hemis National Park
records.key_species: Snow Leopard, Tibetan Wolf, Bharal (Blue Sheep)
records.facts: India's largest national park (approx 4,400 sq km) and highest altitude protected area. Famous for highest density of snow leopards globally.

records.name: Keibul Lamjao National Park
records.key_species: Sangai (Brow-antlered Dancing Deer of Manipur)
records.facts: The world's only floating national park, located on Loktak Lake with floating decomposed plant masses called 'phumdis'.

records.name: Kanha Tiger Reserve
records.key_species: Hardground Barasingha (Swamp Deer), Royal Bengal Tiger, Dhole
records.facts: Inspiration for Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'. First tiger reserve in India to introduce an official mascot: 'Bhoorsingh the Barasingha'.

records.name: Bandipur National Park
records.key_species: Asian Elephant, Tiger, Gaur, Sloth Bear
records.facts: Part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (India's first biosphere reserve, est. 1986). Forms interstate corridor with Mudumalai (TN) and Wayanad (Kerala).

records.name: Periyar National Park
records.key_species: Asian Elephant, Tiger, Lion-tailed Macaque
records.facts: Located in Cardamom and Pandalam hills of Western Ghats around Periyar Lake formed by Mullaperiyar Dam. Periyar and Pamba rivers originate here.

records.name: Silent Valley National Park
records.key_species: Lion-tailed Macaque, Malabar Giant Squirrel
records.facts: Famous for the historic 'Save Silent Valley' movement against a proposed hydroelectric project on the Kunthipuzha River.

records.name: Kuno National Park
records.key_species: Cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus), Leopard, Chinkara
records.facts: Site of India's historic Cheetah Reintroduction Project ('Project Cheetah') launched in September 2022 with translocated African cheetahs.

records.name: Simlipal National Park
records.category: National Park, Biosphere Reserve & Tiger Reserve
records.key_species: Royal Bengal Tiger (Melanistic / Black Tigers), Asian Elephant, Gaur
records.facts: Only known habitat in the world with wild melanistic (black) tigers with broad merged dark stripes.

records.name: Bhitarkanika National Park
records.key_species: Saltwater Crocodile, Olive Ridley Sea Turtle, White Crocodile
records.facts: Second largest mangrove ecosystem in India. Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary adjoining Bhitarkanika is the world's largest nesting beach for Olive Ridley turtles.

records.name: Keoladeo Ghana National Park
records.category: National Park, Ramsar Site & UNESCO World Heritage Site
records.key_species: Siberian Crane (historical), Painted Stork, Migratory Waterfowl
records.facts: Formerly known as Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary. A man-made wetland listed under the Montreux Record of the Ramsar Convention.

records.name: Great Himalayan National Park
records.category: National Park & UNESCO World Heritage Site
records.key_species: Western Tragopan, Himalayan Musk Deer, Snow Leopard
records.facts: Inscribed as UNESCO Natural World Heritage Site in 2014 for outstanding biodiversity in the alpine zone.

records.name: Valley of Flowers National Park
records.category: National Park & UNESCO World Heritage Site
records.key_species: Asiatic Black Bear, Snow Leopard, Musk Deer, Alpine flora
records.facts: Located in the Chamoli district, famous for endemic alpine flower meadows. Discovered by Frank S. Smythe in 1931.

records.name: Namdapha National Park
records.key_species: Tiger, Leopard, Snow Leopard, Clouded Leopard
records.facts: Fourth largest national park in India. Only park hosting four feline species: Tiger, Common Leopard, Snow Leopard, and Clouded Leopard.

records.name: Dachigam National Park
records.key_species: Hangul (Kashmir Stag - Cervus hanglu hanglu)
records.facts: Last remaining sanctuary of the critically endangered Kashmir Stag (Hangul). Located 22 km from Srinagar near Dal Lake catchment.

records.name: Manas National Park
records.category: National Park, Tiger Reserve & UNESCO World Heritage Site
records.key_species: Pygmy Hog, Golden Langur, Hispid Hare, Wild Water Buffalo
records.facts: Located at the foothills of Bhutan Himalayas on the Manas River. Home to rare and endemic pygmy hog and golden langur.
